Name: OBS Control Room
Author: blessdog
Description: Bespoke OBS keys: per-monitor screen share, scene cuts with on-air state, record/mark/pause, mic mute, camera picker, show flow. Companion to the Control Room scene collection.

Actions.Name: Meeting Mode
Actions.Tooltip: Prep a meeting share: Screen + Cam scene with the OBS Virtual Camera on. Press again to turn it off.

Actions.Name: Scene: Starting Soon
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the Starting Soon lava-lamp holding scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Screen L
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the LEFT monitor (full-frame share). The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Screen R
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the RIGHT monitor (full-frame share). The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Cam
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the full camera scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Screen + Cam
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to screen share with camera bubble. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Lava Lounge
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the lava lamp with your background-removed camera. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Ending
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the Ending scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Scene: Cam Cutout
Actions.Tooltip: Cut to the background-removed camera cutout scene. The on-air scene's key lights up.

Actions.Name: Record
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle the OBS recording (cold-starts OBS if needed). Shows elapsed time while recording; recordings land in ~/Movies as corpus material.

Actions.Name: Mark
Actions.Tooltip: While recording: drop a chapter marker into the file itself — flag the moment without stopping. Ingest reads the chapters back out later.

Actions.Name: Mute Mic
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle the shared Mic input. The face follows OBS's own mute state — red slashed mic means muted.

Actions.Name: Camera Picker
Actions.Tooltip: Cycle the shared Camera source between physical cameras (iPhone Continuity ↔ built-in). Face shows which one is live.

Actions.Name: Scene: Me + Float
Actions.Tooltip: Scene: Me + Float

Actions.Name: Scene: BRB
Actions.Tooltip: Scene: BRB

Actions.Name: rectum: Record LEFT monitor
Actions.Tooltip: Record the whole LEFT monitor with its audio; press again to stop and file the clip

Actions.Name: rectum: Record RIGHT monitor
Actions.Tooltip: Record the whole RIGHT monitor with its audio; press again to stop and file the clip

Actions.Name: rectum: Crop last clip
Actions.Tooltip: Find the video inside the clip just recorded and open the proposed crop for review

Actions.Name: rectum: Grab clip from URL
Actions.Tooltip: Paste a video URL (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X…); rectum downloads it into the clip library and reveals it. Pre-filled from the front browser tab.

Actions.Name: Pause Recording
Actions.Tooltip: Pause or resume the running recording. Dim when nothing is recording; the face follows OBS's own pause state.

Actions.Name: Screenshot
Actions.Tooltip: Save a PNG of what is on program to the recording folder's OBS Shots, and reveal it in Finder.

Actions.Name: Reveal Recording
Actions.Tooltip: Open Finder with the newest recording selected. The deck ends at the file — drag it where you like.

Actions.Name: Volume
Actions.Tooltip: Stream Deck + dial for one OBS audio input: rotate ±1.5 dB, press to mute, touch to reset to 0 dB. The strip follows OBS's own volume and mute events.
